facts.fact: Teraco's Riverfields data centre in Bredell, Johannesburg, a carrier-, cloud- and vendor-neutral facility, is in service: Vox says its colocation and cloud services there are in full production (TechCentral, 2018-08-15).

Vox said on 2018-08-15 that it will close its own Vox-operated Waverley, Johannesburg data centre, which hosts colocation customers, by November 2018 and move them to Teraco; the closure was announced, not yet done.
